verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents some error-trend features. Deployment tracking correlates code changes with errors, `occurred.after:'last deploy'` surfaces errors since the latest release, and anomaly detection tracks a project's total error volume against a learned baseline. Insights/BadgerQL also supports aggregations and calculations over event data. None of this is documented as a dashboard view of trends, and nothing shows cross-project or cross-team rollups. Missing for 10: documented error-trend dashboards, cross-project/team aggregation views, a top-regressions view, new-issues-per-release charts, volume-over-time visualizations, and independent corroboration.
